description: Implement an automated release process that publishes updated packages to npm when changes are merged to main. The system should handle version bumps, changelog generation, and publication for multiple packages in the monorepo. This should be triggered through a GitHub action that creates a pull request for review before publishing.
functional_requirements: Automatically create a pull request when changesets are added to main, containing all package updates
Update package.json versions and CHANGELOG.md files for affected packages based on changeset files
Publish packages to npm automatically when the release pull request is merged
Support multiple packages in the monorepo with coordinated versioning
Include clear release notes in the pull request showing what changed in each package
Allow manual control by letting maintainers merge the pull request when ready to release
